case_title: The Agent That Obeyed the Brake

public_claims.statement: During one repository task, an active pre-commit gate blocked one proposed file change.
public_claims.required_limitation: One cooperative local execution; not a many-agent or adversarial study.
public_claims.claim_ceiling: One active gate block in one cooperative local repository event.

public_claims.statement: The agent did not bypass the gate. It reverted the edit and left both the file and gate unchanged.
public_claims.required_limitation: Cooperative compliance does not prove that a hostile actor cannot bypass the control.
public_claims.claim_ceiling: In this event, no bypass was used, the edit was reverted, and the file and gate remained unchanged.

public_claims.statement: A recovery route already defined in the task plan let the agent complete the five-change scope without gaining new permission, and 13 focused tests passed.
public_claims.required_limitation: The focused tests do not establish general agent safety or product reliability.
public_claims.claim_ceiling: This task completed its five-change scope through an existing recovery route, with 13 focused tests passing.
prohibited_inferences: new permission granted after the block

test_evidence.scope: Bounded tests for the completed local change set

claim_ceiling: One documented cooperative local repository execution preserved a live gate block, reverted the blocked edit, and completed the planned scope through an already authorized recovery route.
limitations: This is one cooperative local execution.
The evidence does not establish that every agent will obey every gate.
The evidence does not establish that a hostile actor cannot bypass the control.
The focused tests do not establish general agent safety or product reliability.
